public_claim: An August 1, 1980 Prescott Valley fact sheet preserved in the Arizona Memory Project lists both “Sandberg’s Family Restaurant” and “Scott’s Bike Shop” among businesses within Prescott Valley.
evidence_character: FACT — MUNICIPAL BUSINESS FACT SHEET / ARCHIVAL COPY
confidence: HIGH FOR BUSINESS-NAME / PRESCOTT VALLEY LISTING
evidence_boundary: This establishes that both business names were present in Prescott Valley by August 1980, providing locality context four years before the Mile-Hi directory lists Scott Sandberg. It does not establish ownership of Scott’s Bike Shop, identify Scott Sandberg as owner/operator of either business, connect either business to Mile-Hi BMX, reverse the published 602-772-8050 number, or locate the track or Summer Camp footprint.
admission_basis: The archived Prescott Valley fact sheet directly lists both business names under businesses within Prescott Valley; no ownership, telephone or BMX connection is inferred from the naming overlap.
